ModMetaData.name: Rimshi Skeletons
ModMetaData.author: Matthew
ModMetaData.description:
Skeletons, the ancient proto-mechanical persona from Rim-Skeletons, rebuilt as a Biotech xenotype. No Humanoid Alien Races needed.
They do not eat or sleep, shrug off toxins, heat and disease, run on chemfuel and uranium, and are vanishingly rare among outlanders, pirates, tribes and the Empire.
